summary: Extended sweepStaleClaims/releaseClaim in /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator/daemon.js. releaseClaim now accepts an optional 4th `ctx` parameter ({agentId, mins, tokenUsage}). When provided: (1) writes a continuity note node onto the overlay (title + summary recording agent_id, stale duration, token counts) and wires it as a context edge to the task so the next claimant sees it via get_dependency_summaries; (2) appends a stale_claim_release record to logs/cron-token-usage.jsonl — with real token breakdown if available, or zeros as a minimum observability event. sweepStaleClaims now snapshots taskTranscript/usageCached before calling releaseClaim and passes the ctx. The /sweep POST endpoint (both force and normal paths) likewise passes ctx. All changes are best-effort (wrapped in try/catch) so a note/log failure never blocks the claim release. Syntax-checked and module-load verified.
